-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.Plog` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def plogUpToDate (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (their : entryID) : Bool :=
  have l := plogLast b es;
  decide (uint.Z l.term' < uint.Z their.term' ∨ their.term' = l.term' ∧ uint.Z l.index' ≤ uint.Z their.index')

def plogCommitTo (committed tocommit : w64) : w64 :=
  if uint.Z committed < uint.Z tocommit then tocommit else committed

def plogLastIndexZ (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : Int :=
  uint.Z b.index' + ↑es.length

theorem plogTermAt_none_range (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (i : w64) : plogTermAt b es i = none
    ↔ uint.Z i < uint.Z b.index' ∨ plogLastIndexZ b es < uint.Z i

theorem PlogWf_truncateAppend (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) (e0 : EntryM) : PlogWf b es →
    ents[0]? = some e0 → uint.Z b.index' < uint.Z e0.Index' ∧ uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es
    + 1 → (∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑k) →
    PlogWf b (plogTruncateAppend b es ents)

theorem plogLast_index (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : PlogWf b es → uint.Z (plogLast b
    es).index' = plogLastIndexZ b es

theorem plogTermAt_lookup (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (i : w64) (k : Nat) (e : EntryM) : es[k]?
    = some e → uint.Z i = uint.Z b.index' + ↑(k + 1) → plogTermAt b es i = some e.Term'

theorem plogTermAt_some_range (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (i t : w64) : plogTermAt b es i =
    some t → uint.Z b.index' ≤ uint.Z i ∧ uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es

def plogLast (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : entryID :=
  match es.getLast? with
  | some e => entId e
  | none => b

def plogTruncateAppend (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) : List EntryM :=
  match ents with
  | [] => es
  | e0 :: tail => List.take (uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z b.index' - 1).toNat es ++ ents

theorem plogFrom_prefix_bound (b : entryID) (es es' : List EntryM) (i : w64) (H : es' <+: plogFrom b
    es i) (Hi : uint.Z b.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z i) (Hi2 : uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1) : uint.Z
    i + ↑es'.length ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1

def entId (e : EntryM) : entryID :=
  { term' := e.Term', index' := e.Index' }

def PlogMatches_dec (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (id : entryID) : Decidable (PlogMatches b es
    id) :=
  _root_.id inferInstance

theorem plogTermAt_base (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : plogTermAt b es b.index' = some b.term'

def plogFrom (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (i : w64) : List EntryM :=
  List.drop (uint.Z i - uint.Z b.index' - 1).toNat es

def PlogMatches (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (id : entryID) : Prop :=
  plogTermAt b es id.index' = some id.term'

theorem PlogWf_take (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (n : Nat) : PlogWf b es → PlogWf b (List.take n
    es)

theorem PlogWf_prefix (b : entryID) (es es' : List EntryM) : es <+: es' → PlogWf b es' → PlogWf b es

theorem plogTermAt_last (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : PlogWf b es → plogTermAt b es (plogLast b
    es).index' = some (plogLast b es).term'

def plogFindConflict (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : List EntryM → w64 :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (plogFindConflict._f b es)

theorem getLast?_some_getElem?.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} (l : List A) (e : A) (h : l.getLast? = some e) :
    l[l.length - 1]? = some e

def plogMaybeAppend (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) : Option
    (w64 × List EntryM) :=
  if PlogMatches b es prev then
    have ci := plogFindConflict b es ents;
    have es' :=
      if ci = W64 0 then es else plogTruncateAppend b es (List.drop (uint.Z ci - uint.Z prev.index' - 1).toNat ents);
    some (W64 (uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length), es')
  else none

theorem plogCommitTo_ge (c t : w64) : uint.Z c ≤ uint.Z (plogCommitTo c t)

def PlogWf (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), es[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z b.index' + ↑(k + 1)

theorem PlogWf_app (b : entryID) (es1 es2 : List EntryM) : PlogWf b (es1 ++ es2) ↔ PlogWf b es1 ∧ ∀
    (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), es2[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z b.index' + ↑es1.length + ↑(k
    + 1)

def plogTermAt (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (i : w64) : Option w64 :=
  if uint.Z i < uint.Z b.index' then none
  else
    if uint.Z i = uint.Z b.index' then some b.term'
    else (fun e => e.Term') <$> es[(uint.Z i - uint.Z b.index' - 1).toNat]?
